# Congratulations, Oliver!

It’s been a busy and wonderful month for our sweet boy Oliver!! 🐾

Oliver is our agency’s first dedicated Therapy K9, and he serves as part of our Wellness Team. His presence has been a welcome and comforting addition to us and the community we serve.

We want to celebrate two big milestones for our boy: his 1st birthday on July 8th, and his recent graduation from Therapy K9 school! 🥳

We know that many of you have interacted with Oliver, gained love from his snuggles, and found joy in his sweet personality. We want to congratulate him and his handler, Sgt. Ryan Cornett, on these accomplishments, and thank them for their commitment to helping us all feel whole and well.
